policy: Clockwise square: D/S/A/W, one side per 1.5 native game seconds; new > upgrade > quantity > atk > cd > health > first; no rerolls; native UI clicks.
videoTiming: wallSeconds fields use page navigation performance time; recording may have a small pre-navigation lead. Native HUD game time remains authoritative.
constraints: Fresh isolated save and all permanent upgrades zero.
Native default speed 2 retained; no manual cast/time stepping/XP/level/invulnerability/spawner changes.
Same world seed and initial PRNG stream; native frames, combat and random consumption diverge, so encounters are not paired.
Death is recorded; identical policy and seed restart until cumulative observed game time >= target, maximum 1 attempts.
Near-enemy 150px and half-second no-cast/no-enemy-hit counts are descriptive, not proof of idle bugs; range, cooldown, multi-hit actions and prop attacks differ.

analysis.binCastScope: Player.cast body event timestamps; autonomous guardian counter is reported in castsBySkill/moduleFormation

analysisNote: Offline analysis adds wall-time chapter marks and guardian-rank qualification to army before/after; raw run/video/source unchanged.
